criticalCorrections: Event App Clip preview-only; adding through that route needs full app.
Email/QR landing intentionally opens full app, not App Clip; not every URL an ICS feed.
Reader/Writer/Owner for event and calendar sharing: blanket read-only claim false.
Calendar acceptance requires authenticated verified email.
Recipient receipts/acceptedAt are not reliable RSVP/headcount; anonymous reception and possible receipt failure further limit count interpretation.
Revoking feed and removing recipient are separate; no erasure of independent copies promised.
ICS refresh PT1H is hint, not guaranteed update interval.
No fixed silent-guest fraction or statistical response-rate claims.
